column5: Current master routes lead to four qualifying anticancer intervention protocols, one completed OSA histotripsy experimental cohort, two expressions of its standard-care comparison, and benign lipoma sampling. No new OSA limb-preservation cohort follows from URL text. Thyroid funding conflict is isolated to that protocol and carries no change in roster.

School and UQ VETS show the same current bone cancer vaccine (two formulations in one recruitment identity). Preliminary Enzistat institution news describes intervention and two cohorts separate from bone-cancer vaccine; no current intake on school roster. Check dedicated partner/official intake outside generic article to settle the signal.

Pipeline identifies bladder anti-PD-L1 collaboration and distinct Oct 2025 first-dose Ambifect dog solid-tumor proof of concept. Sponsor news for cats is a weight-management GLP-1 study. No current patient invitation for AKS-619d or other pipeline indication demonstrated; existing no-match watch retained.

Current Hindi ACTREC route resolves to scientific staff biography/publication record with human oncology and cell mechanistic studies. No specific prospective dog/cat intervention or referral route appears; the employment recruitment link is not patient intake.

Current page is a legacy 2013 list of public oncologic care and old Auranofin OSA study links. BVSC's separately checked study page describes completed prior Auranofin research and completed subsequent diagnostic PET-CT cohort, not a national recruiting roster.

Native Japanese hospital index distinguishes anti-CD20 lymphoid cohort and historic broad PD-1, finished reovirus, and biomarker sampling. Provider's current three-site study is oral melanoma. Missing current broad older PD-1 indication, where available, requires direct partner clarification before interpreting as a separate enrolment.

Official legacy sponsor list separately names four groups: Tel-eVax cat/dog, and Erb-eVax canine OSA, canine TCC/prostate, feline mammary. Unclear current year/clinic intake, companion VOS site returned server error in both methods, historical contacts do not establish availability.
